craft_notes: Sthāyin: protocol — fitness-graded worship. Rows: outer/inner balance. Rejected: clarifying tathānugam — killed: junction flagged, rite-sequence secure. Read aloud: measured steps.

lines: Praise the wheel as befits, and the lesser wheel behind —
without with blossoms to the inmost; within with scent and savor, wine and more.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cakram arcet tadaucityād anucakraṃ tathānugam bahiḥ puṣpādināntaś ca gandhabhuktyāsavādibhiḥ
